dedupe_keys.name: england and wales residential heat demand and measures

description: The UK Energy Research Centre deposit combines three data products for residential heat planning in England and Wales. It reports annual heat demand by Lower Layer Super Output Area and sixteen dwelling categories before and after efficiency measures, normalised half-hourly heating profiles, and local-authority measure costs. A modeller can use the demand and cost tables to compare electrification, district-heat or retrofit pathways at area scale. Normalised profiles require an annual demand assumption, and the administrative summaries do not identify every individual building. The own UKERC page names the component data and states CC BY 4.0; its DOI registration omits rights. I read the named landing page and Scientific Data descriptor without downloading the data or testing the example notebooks. The linked preparation repository is a separate resource. No exact catalogue heat-demand record was found.
